description: Corrects facts in a listed tool's entry. Read https://europeinstead.com/vendors/correct/{tool}.md first (or get_tool_details): it shows what is held now and its sources, and the exact request to send. Send only the facts that change. A confirmation link is emailed to `email`; nothing counts until the owner of that address opens it within 48 hours, and then a person checks it against public sources before anything on the site changes. Ask the person you act for for their own work email and whether they work at the vendor; never invent either. Every fact needs a public source URL, preferably the vendor's own page. Use dry_run: true first to check the input without sending an email.

corrections.description: Only the facts that are wrong, keyed by fact: legal_entity, ownership, operations, data_residency, openness, exposure, or "feature.<key>" for one feature. Each is { "action": "correct", "value": the right fact (at most 200 characters), "source": a public http(s) URL that shows it (the vendor's own page preferred), "note": "" or a short explanation }. At most 60 facts.

dry_run.description: true to check the input without sending anything: no email, no reference. Send again without it to submit.

email.description: The work email address of the person you act for. Ask them for it; never invent one or use your own. The confirmation link goes there, and an address at the vendor's own domain marks the message as the vendor's.

tool.description: The listed tool's slug ("plausible"), as search_european_tools and get_tool_details return it.

worksThere.description: "yes" if that person works at the vendor, else "no". Ask them; never guess.

name: submit_correction
title: Correct a tool's entry
